description: This file defines a class Image_Graph_Plotarea_Element which models a plot area element in a graph, inheriting from Image_Graph_Element. It provides private methods to convert data points to pixel positions along the X and Y axes, used in graphical rendering.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea_Element
classes.description: Represents an element within a plot area in a graph, capable of converting data coordinates to pixel positions for rendering.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Converts a data point to its pixel position along the X axis.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Converts a data point to its pixel position along the Y axis.

methods.name: _pointXY
methods.description: Returns both X and Y pixel positions for a given data point as an associative array.
